t: Itsy Bitsy (2019) ⭐ 4.6 | Fantasy, Horror, Mystery
s: December 30, 2019 - The audience knows what is eventually coming, and that's largely why we're watching: we want to see this gross, huge spider poison and spider web cocoon people to death! That and the ancient mythology behind the spider's existence just feels boring. Itsy Bitsy is well made with decent performances.
